svg.text: Breast cancer segmentation — model plan
CBIS-DDSM masses · the architecture ladder and why each rung is in the talk · grounded in cours/04_les_modeles.md
THE QUESTION THAT ORDERS EVERYTHING — fil rouge, modules 1 to 4
The lesion margin is a local shape property, and it is the margin that
carries the diagnosis: a spiculated contour signals infiltration.
So the only architectural question that matters here is
which networks preserve that margin, and which smooth it away (§4.2).
THE NUMBER THAT DECIDES EVERYTHING — §4.1, Lee et al. Table 3
748 mass anomalies train / 222 test → at most ~1500 image-mask pairs
After a patient-grouped validation split: ~600 training anomalies.
Transformer from scratch: excluded. Pretrained encoder: mandatory.
Heavy augmentation: mandatory. Cross-validation over a single split.
CONSTRAINT
receptive field
vs resolution
Image ~3000x5000 px.
Spicule: a few px wide.
Resize the whole image
Keeps: global context, position in breast
Loses: high frequency — spicules,
microcalcifications. 3000→512 divides
resolution by ~7: the signal is gone (§5.2).
Tile into patches
Keeps: native resolution, so fine detail
Loses: context — where am I in the breast?
Sampling ratio of lesion vs empty tiles is
a hyperparameter, not a detail (§5.3).
Two stages: coarse then fine
Keeps: both context and resolution
Costs: complexity, and stage-1 misses are
final. What a radiologist does, and what
Shen 2019 does. This project takes it.
A1
The floor
nnU-Net
nnU-Net — not an architecture, a configuration method
From a fingerprint of the dataset it derives preprocessing, patch size,
batch size, depth, augmentation and training schedule by fixed rules.
Run the 2D config on the ROI patches with zero tuning, 5-fold.
Hardest baseline to beat in medical segmentation — won the MSD.
Role: the honest floor
This is what you get without thinking. Do not spend
the semester trying to beat it — §5.5 calls that the
black hole of segmentation projects. If you do not
beat it, say so: a real and frequent result.
MARGIN §4.2
preserved
A2
Your controlled
baseline
U-Net, ImageNet-pretrained ResNet encoder, Dice + BCE
Skip connections reinject high-frequency detail at each decoder level.
They are the mechanism that preserves the margin (§3.2) — the whole
fil rouge has its architectural counterpart right there.
Trained on ROI patches at native resolution, never on resized wholes.
Role: the model you actually control
Every rung below is measured against this one.
Target ~0.75-0.80 Dice — that is the quality of the
labels themselves (module 1), not a ceiling to push
past. First thing built once the pipeline gates pass.
MARGIN §4.2
preserved
A3
One motivated
variation
Attention U-Net — or — a boundary / focal loss term
Attention gates weight what each skip reinjects. On a mammogram almost
all of the image is background, and plain skips reinject that background
as faithfully as the lesion. Focal upweights ambiguous pixels, which are
mostly boundary pixels (§3.8). Pick one. One factor, one change.
Role: show a mechanism, not a score
Judge it on HD95 and ASSD, not on Dice.
+2 Dice would not be significant at this n (module 3).
A boundary effect visible on HD95 and absent on Dice
is the interesting result — the fil rouge, demonstrated.
MARGIN §4.2
preserved
A4
Diversity,
on purpose
The rung I would
have cut.
Mask R-CNN · DeepLabv3+ — the contrast family
Mask R-CNN: an RPN proposes boxes, ROI-Align crops them, a mask head
emits 28x28 per box, stretched back up (§3.5). Buys instance separation
and a per-lesion score, so FROC becomes directly computable.
DeepLabv3+: ASPP and dilated convs, output stride 1/8 then upsampling.
Role: the diversity-of-methods grid line
Both are expected to lose on contour, and explaining
why structurally is worth more than winning.
28x28 stretched over a 400 px mass cannot hold a
spicule; DeepLab's final upsampling smooths the edge.
MARGIN §4.2
R-CNN: lost
DeepLab: blurred
A5
Scale-up
Shen recipe
ROI-patch encoder → full-image segmentation (§3.9)
Shen 2019: train a patch classifier on ROI crops, then convert it into a
whole-image model by swapping the head and reusing the whole trunk.
Transposed here: train A2 on ROI patches, then reuse its encoder for
full-image inference. The encoder already knows what a lesion looks like.
Role: turns segmentation into detection
Only here do FPPI and FROC mean anything, because only
here does the model meet normal tissue it can hallucinate
on. Expect a drop against patch-level Dice: that drop is
itself a result. Never report patch Dice as detection.
MARGIN §4.2
preserved
SEPARATOR
what tells the
rungs apart
module 3
evaluation/metrics.py — metrics that can see a margin
Dice / IoU: area overlap. Blind to the margin, and rewards smoothing.
HD95 / ASSD: boundary error. This is where A3 has to show up.
Per-lesion sensitivity + false positives per image; FROC where scores exist.
Empty masks: separate true negatives, misses and false alarms explicitly.
The statistical discipline that makes a ranking real
Cross-validation, not a single split: at ~600 anomalies a single split reorders
the models when you change the random seed (§5.7).
Patient-level bootstrap for intervals. Declare test-time augmentation (§5.6).
Stratify by density, subtlety, pathology, view — with n. This is where the marks are.
DELIVERABLE
the exposé
not the repo
Evaluation.pdf,
scored out of 10
Which grid line each part of the work feeds
Theory + diversity of methods/algorithms → the A1-A4 ladder
Practice + validation → the separator row, splits, pipeline gates
Results obtained → stratified tables, the HD95 effect, the FROC curve
Slide and figure quality is itself a graded line — hence these schematics.
Fatal at the oral (§5)
SAM / MedSAM prompted with the ground-truth box: you handed the model the
answer to the question you claim to ask. Legitimate as contour refinement —
write that in full on the slide, and never call it detection (§3.7).
Quoting your Dice against a paper's: different protocol, not comparable.
Build status
planned — no code written yet
constraint, rule or assessment — decided, not built
settled fact
hazard — costs marks if ignored
Margin verdict
preserved
full output resolution, skips carry the high frequency
blurred
low output stride, final upsampling smooths the edge
lost
no mechanism at all
Every architecture claim here comes from cours/04_les_modeles.md; the margin verdicts are §4.2, which flags them as inference from output resolution, not measured on CBIS-DDSM.
Companion to coding_plan.svg, which holds the pipeline and its test gates. That file is the service lane for this one: infrastructure exists so this ladder can be run and defended.
Order of build is not order of importance: A2 comes first in code, A4 carries the diversity mark, and the stratified analysis of the separator row is where the grade is decided.
